next_pending: Opening the service's authorization page. One moment.
next_success: Return to Tofi to start using it.
next_denied: To keep going, return to Tofi, check the account's permissions and try again.
next_failed: Return to Tofi, check the connection settings and authorize again.
setup_enable_body: In the same Google Cloud project as the OAuth client, enable the services below, then return to Tofi and refresh the tools.
setup_preview: The Cloud project must be enrolled in the Google Workspace Developer Preview Program (developers.google.com/workspace/preview). Otherwise every tool call is still rejected after authorization succeeds.
setup_agent_client: The OAuth client must have "Use this client for an AI-powered agent" checked. From 2026-11-11 Workspace MCP rejects unmarked clients, and from 2026-11-12 the setting is fixed, so a new client is required.
audience_body: While the app is in testing mode, only test users can authorize. Add the current account under Audience, then try again.
msg_pending: You are about to confirm access with the service provider. Grant only the permissions this task needs.
msg_callback_invalid: This authorization could not be verified. The link may have expired or already been used. Return to Tofi and connect again.
msg_denied: The provider did not grant access. The authorization may have been cancelled, or the account may not meet the app's access conditions. Check the setup and connect again.
msg_connected_none: Connected, but this service doesn't list any tools yet.
msg_auth_rejected: Authorization was saved, but the service does not accept this sign-in yet. Return to Tofi and authorize again.
msg_saved_unusable: Authorization saved, but the tools aren't usable yet.
msg_saved_unreadable: Authorization saved, but the tools can't be read right now.
msg_gog_failed: Google authorization could not be completed. Return to Tofi and try again.
msg_gog_saved: Authorization saved, but Gmail can't be read right now. Check in Tofi.
diag_api_disabled: Google reports the API is not enabled. In the same project as the OAuth client, enable the product API and the MCP service, then refresh the tools.
diag_access_denied: Google denied access. If the app is in testing mode, check that the current account is a test user; an account or organization restriction is also possible.
diag_permission_denied: Google refused to list the tools. First confirm the Cloud project is enrolled in the Google Workspace Developer Preview Program, then that the OAuth client has "Use this client for an AI-powered agent" checked (from 2026-11-11 Workspace MCP rejects unmarked clients; the setting is fixed after 11-12, so a new client is required); finally check the API / MCP enablement and the account's permissions. A 401 / 403 alone cannot tell which one it is.
